about.title: About me
about.description: I am a full-stack developer. I code websites, applications, software, and games. I am passionate about video games and their creative aspects, which inspire me in my own creations. I enjoy drawing. I am interested in new technologies and computer science in general. I am curious by nature and enjoy experimenting.
